summary: 为 Pi 编程 agent 设计的自洽模块化开发流水线：需求→BDD→调研→spec→TDD→评审→合并，可组合控制流节点代数。
description: Self-contained, modular development pipeline for the Pi coding agent (requirements → BDD → research → spec → TDD implementation → review → merge). Composable control-flow node algebra; no external workflow engine.
